title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a technique used to analyze multiple regression data that suffer from multicollinearity. It introduces a penalty term, controlled by the parameter lambda, to the loss function. This penalty term helps to shrink the coefficients and reduce overfitting.

title: Interpreting the Plots
text: When looking at the plots, consider how the mean squared error (MSE) changes as lambda increases. A plot showing a decrease in MSE followed by an increase might indicate a balance between bias and variance.

title: Identifying Training Error
text: Which plot shows a consistent increase in error as lambda increases, indicating overfitting is being reduced?
